crossRefs.note: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.
Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne
that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

translations.web: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.
translations.bsb: And He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated on the throne.
translations.kjv: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
translations.asv: And he came, and he taketh it out of the right hand of him that sat on the throne.
